extracted.name: Bread Machine Cottage Cheese Bread
extracted.description: The bread machine does it all after you measure in routine bread ingredients and a cup of cottage cheese. You can cut fat and calories in this hearty loaf by using nonfat cottage cheese if you prefer.
instruction_lines: Add ingredients to your bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer, and start. You can use up to 1/2 cup more bread flour if dough seems too sticky.
